sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent infrastructure dominates today's GitHub snapshot: OpenStock leads the displayed star-gain signal, while computer-use, agent-native application frameworks, agent memory, and secure agent environments fill much of the list.

sections.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
sections.description: A framework for building agentic apps

sections.title: trycua/cua
sections.description: Open-source infrastructure for computer-use drivers, cross-OS fleets, benchmarks, training, evaluation, and data generation.

sections.title: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock
sections.description: An open-source alternative to commercial market platforms with prices, alerts, and company insights.

sections.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
sections.description: Long-term memory for agent coding CLIs and handoff between agent vendors.

sections.title: coder/coder
sections.description: Secure environments for developers and their agents.

sections.title: cloudflare/quiche
sections.description: Savoury implementation of QUIC and HTTP/3.

sections.title: mvt-project/mvt
sections.description: Mobile forensics tooling for finding signs of device compromise.

sections.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
sections.description: AI-powered video clipping and highlight generation.

sections.title: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
sections.description: Offline-first knowledge and education server with optional local AI.

sections.title: yynxxxxx/Codex-X
sections.description: Cross-platform visual management for OpenAI Codex desktop/CLI workflows.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent infrastructure, self-hosted/offline AI, applied AI products, and a balanced TypeScript/Rust/Python language mix.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The snapshot emphasizes the surrounding agent stack—memory, computer-use evaluation, secure execution, configuration, and domain-specific applications—alongside offline-first infrastructure.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: GitHub is in an ecosystem-building phase for AI agents, with investment moving into persistence, security, deployment, and workflow integration.
